trellis2-car-001: Volumetric but boxy car with weak wheels; source registration and clipping unresolved.

trellis2-oak-sdxl055-001: Local img2img strength 0.55 retains pixel-art/ground appearance and returns a flat card; pipeline stops before fitting/export.
trellis2-oak-sdxl08-seed1-001: Identical regenerated local reference bytes, alternate TRELLIS.2 seed 1: volumetric crown/trunk again, with the same blotchy texture problem. Two seeds support geometry feasibility, not robustness across arbitrary assets.
oak-local-sdxl08-001: Entirely local SDXL 0.8 → MV-Adapter six views → U2Net → selected angle 0 → TRELLIS.2: volumetric tree with more legible generated colors than direct SDXL conditioning. Rounded lobe geometry and source alignment remain hypotheses; not accepted art or clipping.
trellis2-oak-sdxl095-001: Entirely local direct img2img strength 0.95: volumetric leafy tree with more coherent generated texture than direct 0.8. Greater crown/trunk interpretation drift; does not recover unique hidden geometry. All model stages completed; the wrapper shell was edited while running and exited afterward, so texture capture was run separately.
oak-local-full-seed1-001: Complete default local launcher with mesh seed 1: generated reference, six views, learned masks, volumetric TRELLIS mesh, fit/bake/comparison, textured GLB, interactive viewer and report all succeeded. Crown/trunk volume persists, with visible texture mottling and surface fragments; appearance varies by mesh seed.
